data.title: 泽塔 · 月夜森林的侦察
data.description: 月夜的密林里，泽塔无声地穿行在枝叶之间。教团的秘密集会就在林间空地——她伏在树冠上，把每个人的脸都记进脑海。
data.location: dense moonlit forest with a clearing where hooded figures gather around a fire
data.action: perched silently on a tree branch above a clearing, watching a secret gathering below
data.lighting: 密林间漏下的皎洁月光与空地篝火
data.mood: noiseless infiltration, hunter in the canopy
data.promptProse: From the moonlit canopy, Zeta memorizes every hooded face around the fire. None of them look up.
data.animaCaption: Twenty faces around a fire, and not one of them knows the leopard is watching.
